story.text: 밤이 깊어지자 금강 변 벤치에 나란히 앉았습니다. 강바람이 제법 선선했습니다.
story.reading: bam-i gip-eo-ji-ja geum-gang byeon ben-chi-e na-ran-hi anj-at-seum-ni-da. gang-ba-ram-i je-beop seon-seon-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: As the night deepened, we sat side by side on a bench by the Geumgang River. The river breeze was fairly cool.

story.text: 친구의 표정이 어딘가 무거워 보였습니다. "요즘 무슨 '고민' 있습니까?" 제가 먼저 조심스레 물었습니다.
story.reading: chin-gu-ui pyo-jeong-i eo-din-ga mu-geo-wo bo-yeot-seum-ni-da. "yo-jeum mu-seun 'go-min' it-seum-ni-kka?" je-ga meon-jeo jo-sim-seu-re mul-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: My friend's expression looked somehow heavy. "Do you have some 'worry' these days?" I asked cautiously first.

story.text: 잠시 망설이던 친구가 결국 마음속 이야기를 '털어놓았습니다.' 저는 말없이 끝까지 들었습니다.
story.reading: jam-si mang-seol-i-deon chin-gu-ga gyeol-guk ma-eum-sok i-ya-gi-reul 'teol-eo-noh-at-seum-ni-da.' jeo-neun mal-eob-si kkeut-kka-ji deul-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: After hesitating for a moment, my friend finally 'opened up' about what was on their mind. I listened quietly, all the way to the end.

story.text: 평소라면 격식 있는 조언부터 건넸을 텐데, 오늘은 그저 옆에 있어 주고 싶었습니다.
story.reading: pyeong-so-ra-myeon gyeok-sik it-neun jo-eon-bu-teo geon-naess-eul ten-de, o-neul-eun geu-jeo yeop-e it-eo ju-go sip-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Normally I would have offered some formal-sounding advice first, but today I just wanted to be there beside my friend.

story.text: "괜찮습니다. 잘 견디고 있는 겁니다." 서툴지만 진심을 담아 '위로하려' 애썼습니다.
story.reading: "gwaen-chan-seum-ni-da. jal gyeon-di-go it-neun geob-ni-da." seo-tul-ji-man jin-sim-eul dam-a 'wi-ro-ha-ryeo' ae-sseot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "It's okay. You're doing well, holding up." Clumsy as it was, I tried hard to 'comfort' them with sincerity.

story.text: 저 역시 비슷한 순간을 지나온 적이 있어, 그 마음에 깊이 '공감할' 수 있었습니다.
story.reading: jeo yeok-si bi-seut-han sun-gan-eul ji-na-on jeog-i it-eo, geu ma-eum-e gip-i 'gong-gam-hal' su it-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: I too had once gone through a similar moment, so I could deeply 'empathize' with those feelings.

story.text: "힘들 때는 언제든 불러도 됩니다." 낮은 목소리에 '진심'을 꾹꾹 눌러 담았습니다.
story.reading: "him-deul ttae-neun eon-je-deun bul-leo-do doem-ni-da." naj-eun mok-so-ri-e 'jin-sim'-eul kkuk-kkuk nul-leo dam-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "Whenever things get hard, you can call me anytime." I packed 'sincerity' into every word of my low voice.

story.text: 강물 위로 달빛이 조용히 흔들리고 있었습니다. 그날 밤 나눈 대화를 들려드리겠습니다.
story.reading: gang-mul wi-ro dal-bit-i jo-yong-hi heun-deul-li-go it-eot-seum-ni-da. geu-nal bam na-nun dae-hwa-reul deul-lyeo-deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Moonlight quietly rippled over the river's surface. Let me share the conversation we had that night.

words.example_en: I've had a small worry lately.

words.meaning: to open up, to confess one's feelings
words.example_en: I opened up to my friend about my true feelings.
I sincerely comforted my sad friend.
I deeply empathize with those feelings too.
I said those words with sincerity.

sentences.en: I've had a small worry lately.
I opened up to my friend about my true feelings.
I sincerely comforted my sad friend.
I deeply empathize with those feelings too.
I said those words with sincerity.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 표정이 안 좋아 보입니다. 무슨 고민이라도 있습니까?
turns.reading: pyo-jeong-i an jo-a bo-im-ni-da. mu-seun go-min-i-ra-do it-seum-ni-kka?
turns.en: You don't look well. Do you have some kind of worry?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 사실... 요즘 회사 일 때문에 좀 힘들어.
turns.reading: sa-sil... yo-jeum hoe-sa il ttae-mun-e jom him-deul-eo.
turns.en: Actually... lately I've been struggling because of work.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 그랬군요. 편하게 다 털어놓아도 됩니다. 끝까지 듣겠습니다.
turns.reading: geu-raet-gu-nyo. pyeon-ha-ge da teol-eo-noh-a-do doem-ni-da. kkeut-kka-ji deut-get-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: I see. Feel free to open up about all of it. I'll listen until the end.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 고마워. 너한테 말하니까 벌써 마음이 좀 놓인다.
turns.reading: go-ma-wo. neo-han-te mal-ha-ni-kka beol-sseo ma-eum-i jom noh-in-da.
turns.en: Thanks. Just telling you already makes me feel a bit more at ease.

dialogues.question: 승객이 상우에게 털어놓은 고민의 원인은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What was the cause of the worry the passenger opened up to Sangwoo about?
dialogues.explanation: 승객은 요즘 회사 일 때문에 힘들다고 상우에게 털어놓았습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 너도 이런 고민 해 본 적 있어?
turns.reading: neo-do i-reon go-min hae bon jeog it-seo?
turns.en: Have you ever had a worry like this too?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: Of course. I fully empathize with how you feel.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그런 너를 보니까 좀 위로가 된다.
turns.reading: geu-reon neo-reul bo-ni-kka jom wi-ro-ga doen-da.
turns.en: Seeing you like that comforts me a little.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 다행입니다. 이 말, 진심으로 하는 겁니다. 언제든 불러 주십시오.
turns.reading: da-haeng-im-ni-da. i mal, jin-sim-eu-ro ha-neun geob-ni-da. eon-je-deun bul-leo ju-sip-si-o.
turns.en: I'm glad. I mean this with complete sincerity — please call me anytime.

dialogues.question: 상우가 승객의 고민에 공감할 수 있었던 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why was Sangwoo able to empathize with the passenger's worry?
dialogues.correct_answer: 자신도 비슷한 고민을 겪어 본 적이 있어서
options: 자신도 비슷한 고민을 겪어 본 적이 있어서
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 자신도 비슷한 순간을 겪어 봤기 때문에 승객의 마음에 깊이 공감할 수 있었다고 말했습니다.
